label_source: deterministic (gold matching); the questions were written and screened by LLM agents and the passages checked by the judge of the rebuilt broad track
what: track p2: 480 groups whose question was written for two passages of books of two programs, screened, and both passages judged full answers, as pre-registered; the blind baseline resolves one row per group

rules.group: written, passed the screen, judged clear, no 'tidak' or unreadable verdict for either passage under either wording, both passages of one class in wording A
rules.pool: both passages and the 69 chunks with the highest cosine to either passage, ties by chunk id

bge_gemma: documented placement (slot_vendor, both_vendor, wrong_vendor) in every family; its appended slot and both cells are secondary (pre-registration 11.1 a)
